Introduced a dedicated `RandomProvider` service in [RandomProvider.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/RandomProvider.java:1) and removed the old static `Randomizer` helper. `Simulator` now owns the provider for a run and threads it into the simulation graph through constructor injection in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java:12).

The model now pulls randomness from that service instead of global static calls. `Field`, `Weather`, and `ActorFactory` each keep a provider reference for their random operations in [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Field.java:9), [Weather.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Weather.java:9), and [ActorFactory.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/ActorFactory.java:8). `Organism` now carries the provider so `Animal`, `Plant`, `Hunter`, and disease creation all use the same injected source in [Organism.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Organism.java:1) and [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Animal.java:13).
